cve_summary: The do_core_note function in readelf.c in libmagic.a in file 5.33 allows remote attackers to cause a denial of service (out-of-bounds read and application crash) via a crafted ELF file.
commit_message: Avoid reading past the end of buffer (Rui Reis)
